description: Retrieve native PlumX metrics for one publication or artifact by identifier. Returns the original Elsevier JSON, including metric categories, count types and sources. Requires active Scopus access. HTTP 404 can mean that no metrics are available or that the identifier is unknown.

idType.description: Identifier namespace used to locate the publication or artifact in PlumX.

idValue.description: Identifier in the selected namespace, e.g. 10.1103/physrevlett.116.061102 for doi. Supply the original value without URL encoding; a lone . or .. is not allowed.

reqId.description: Caller-supplied request identifier for tracing this request with Elsevier support.

name: plumx_metrics

name.description: Name of the metric type within its category.
Name of the source contributing this metric.

total.description: Metric count reported by this source, as a JSON number.

sources.description: Per-source breakdown for this metric type; may be absent or null.

total.description: Total count for this metric type, as reported by PlumX.

count_types.description: Metric types contributing to this category; may be absent or null.

name.description: PlumX metric category name; categories are not restricted to a fixed list.

total.description: Total count for this metric category, as reported by PlumX.

count_categories.description: Available PlumX metric categories and their counts; may be absent or null.

title: PlumX Metrics
